facts.fact: Ministerial order no. 018 of 15 July 2025 gave Starlink a provisional authorisation to establish and operate a public network, pending an individual C1C licence.

ARTCI decision no. 2025-1301 of 25 September 2025 authorised Starlink Network CIV to use eight frequency bands for a non-geostationary satellite network, letting it legally provide fixed internet access.
